interests.interestText: 1-5 May 2023: I visited Houston and Atlanta in the USA to speak at two events marking the 25th anniversary of the Belfast (Good Friday) Agreement, organised by the Irish Consul General in Texas and in Georgia. The costs of travel, accommodation and hospitality (costing approximately �2,400) were met by the Government of Ireland. (Registered 19 May 2023) 12-13 March 2023: I visited New York to attend a seminar on Northern Ireland organised by the National Committee on American Foreign Policy (NCAFP). The cost of two nights accommodation (costing approximately �500) were met by the NCAFP. All other costs, including flights, were met by the Ulster Unionist Party. (Registered 19 May 2023) 24-26 September 2023: I visited Boston to speak at an event to mark the 25th Anniversary of the 1998 Agreement, which was organised by the Edward M Kennedy Institute. The cost of return flights and two nights' accommodation (totalling �1,060 approximately) were met by the Kennedy Institute. (Registered 2 October 2023)
